# `pacvamp aur rebuild`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp aur rebuild <--image <IMAGE>> [--json] <ARTIFACT>`

Rebuild an approved receipt using retained sources and an identical Arch image

## Arguments
- **`<ARTIFACT>`**

## Flags
- **`--image <IMAGE>`** — Retained image with the same contents as the original build
- **`--json`**
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
